tips: Keep digital copies of all travel documents.
Avoid displaying expensive jewelry or electronics in public.
Share your live location with family via Google Maps.
Drink only bottled or filtered water.
Respect local dress codes, especially at religious sites.
Watch out for common pickpockets in busy markets like Chandni Chowk or Colaba.
Be wary of 'string' or 'friendship bracelet' scams near Sacré-Cœur.
Keep your bag in front of you on the Metro.
Avoid the Gare du Nord area late at night if alone.

visa_info.requirement: No visa required for Indian citizens. Valid ID (Aadhar/Voter ID) is sufficient.
Schengen Visa required. Apply at least 4 weeks in advance via VFS Global.
Pre-arranged or OK-on-board Visa/eVisa required for Indian passport holders.
